header: "WHAT IS THE DATE OF BIRTH / DATE OF JOINING OF SOMEBODY?" (step 65b; my rule, 1 Nov 2026: no user can search the date of birth or the date of joining of an employee by the search bar except the HOD of C&IT). PURE. Here I only READ the sentence: which facts are asked, and about whom. Whether the person may know it is decided elsewhere (datesLookup.ts), by the login. The protected facts are those two dates and what they give away: the age ("how old is ..."), the day of retirement ("when does ... retire") and the length of service ("how long has ... served"). dob "dob of Rakesh Ojha", "date of birth of 498880", "Rakesh Ojha's birthday", "when was Rakesh Ojha born" doj "doj of ...", "date of joining of ...", "joining date of 498880", "when did Rakesh Ojha join" age "age of ...", "how old is ..." retire "retirement date of ...", "when does ... retire" service "years of service of ...", "length of service of ...", "how long has ... served" WHO is a six-digit ticket number or one to four words of a name. For a sentence with no person ("birthdays today", "age limit", "joining instructions") I return null: it is not about anybody here.

symbols.name: FILLER
doc: These are words that belong to the question, never to the name.

symbols.name: NOT_A_NAME
doc: Words that show the sentence is about a SUBJECT, not about a person ("who has birthday today", "age limit", "joining instructions", "the retirement age policy of the company"): such a sentence is not a question about somebody's dates, and I make no directory look-up for it. No employee is named like these.
